title: Mastering Drain Trap Seals and Siphonage Prevention
description: Drain traps are a critical component of any sanitary drainage system, serving as the primary barrier against sewer gas entering a building. Every plumbing fixture must be equipped with a properly vented trap that maintains a liquid water seal. Without adequate venting, the discharge of a fixture can induce negative pressure, pulling or siphoning the water right out of the trap and leaving the living space open to hazardous gases and foul odors. Understanding how trap seals function and why proper venting is required is essential for every plumbing professional ensuring safe and sanitary installations.

Mastering Drain Trap Seals and Siphonage Prevention

Drain traps are a critical component of any sanitary drainage system, serving as the primary barrier against sewer gas entering a building. Every plumbing fixture must be equipped with a properly vented trap that maintains a liquid water seal. Without adequate venting, the discharge of a fixture can induce negative pressure, pulling or siphoning the water right out of the trap and leaving the living space open to hazardous gases and foul odors. Understanding how trap seals function and why proper venting is required is essential for every plumbing professional ensuring safe and sanitary installations.
